import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import sys

source_repo=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
sys.path.insert(0,str(source_repo/"src"))
from do_again.service.rollout import _tree_hash

projects=[Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe"),Path("/Users/steventran/Sonary")]
source_pkg=source_repo/"src/do_again"

def files(root):
    out={}
    for p in sorted(x for x in root.rglob("*") if x.is_file()):
        rel=p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        out[rel]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return out

source_files=files(source_pkg)
rows=[]
for repo in projects:
    key=hashlib.sha256(str(repo.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    runtime=Path.home()/".do_again/projects"/key/"runtime/do_again"
    runtime_files=files(runtime)
    only_source=sorted(set(source_files)-set(runtime_files))
    only_runtime=sorted(set(runtime_files)-set(source_files))
    diff=sorted(k for k in set(source_files)&set(runtime_files) if source_files[k]!=runtime_files[k])
    rows.append({
      "repo":str(repo),
      "source_canonical_tree_hash":_tree_hash(source_pkg),
      "runtime_canonical_tree_hash":_tree_hash(runtime),
      "canonical_match":_tree_hash(source_pkg)==_tree_hash(runtime),
      "source_file_count":len(source_files),
      "runtime_file_count":len(runtime_files),
      "only_source":only_source,
      "only_runtime":only_runtime,
      "different_content":diff,
      "critical_equal":{
        rel: source_files.get(rel)==runtime_files.get(rel)
        for rel in [
          "service/daemon.py",
          "service/liveness.py",
          "service/rollout.py",
          "core/schema.py",
          "browser/runtime.py",
          "service/service.py"
        ]
      }
    })
print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
print("CANONICAL_RUNTIME_HASH_DIAGNOSTIC_OK")
